name: Fixed-Horizon Thicket-Maximum Classes Need Not Be Partial Cubes
scope: Finite displayed Boolean classes, compared through their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Not every member of fixed-horizon thicket-maximum classes is a partial cube.
proof: The class $H'$ has Littlestone dimension one and realizes both answers to a one-query tree, so it is $(1,1)$-thicket-maximum; its one-inclusion graph is disconnected.
